system.description: Ten minutes alone with a captive is all you need. Test Presence (DR14) to question a captured creature that can speak. Triumph: it answers three questions truthfully, and gives up a name it was keeping back. Success: it answers two questions truthfully. Failure: it tells you nothing of use, and cannot be questioned again until the next day. Ruin: it feeds you a lie you believe, and whoever it served learns that you are coming.
